name: Carrot-Pear Soup with Cheddar & Nutty Strawberry-Orange Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 pears
6 medium carrots
6 sticks celery
1 ½ limes
1 ½ (454 g) pkgs strawberries
3 oranges

instructions.primary_message: Quarter, core, and small dice pears. Place in a medium bowl. (Reserve a small handful of pear for serving.)
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery. Add both to the bowl with the pear.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pear, veggies, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into a clean medium bowl. Add honey and salt, then whisk to combine the dressing. Set aside.

When the veggies have softened, add broth to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer; cook, stirring occasionally, until pear and veggies are tender, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the soup is cooking, trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Peel oranges, separate into segments, and roughly chop the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts and dates. Add both to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup walnuts
⅓ cup medjool dates, pitted

instructions.primary_message: Coarsely grate cheese. Set aside for serving.
When the pear and veggies are tender, using a hand blender, purée the soup until smooth. (If using a regular blender, work in batches as needed, then return soup to the pot.)
Divide soup between bowls, then top with cheese and reserved pear. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
